newsitem.title: UK: Airtours to form new unit in California.
newsitem.headline: Airtours to form new unit in California.

text.p: UK holiday tour company Airtours Plc said on Friday it is forming a new tour operating subsidiary company, Sunquest Holdings Inc., based in California, US.
Airtours said the company will trade as Sunquest Holidays and will operate from Los Angeles with a potential customer base in California roughly equal to that of the UK market.
Sunquest Holidays will form part of a new Division of Airtours plc which will be under the management of Leo Desrochers, CEO of Airtours' Canadian tour operations.
The new Division will be called the North American Leisure Group, said Airtours.
From April 1997, Sunquest Holidays will provide holidays from departure points in Southern California to destinations in Hawaii, Mexico and the Caribbean.
